crossRefs.note: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.

people.name: Jemimah
people.line: One of Job's daughters born after his restoration.

people.name: Keren-happuch
people.line: Job's third daughter born after his restoration

people.name: Keziah
people.line: Job's second daughter born after his restoration

translations.web: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.
translations.bsb: He named his first daughter Jemimah, his second Keziah, and his third Keren-happuch.
translations.kjv: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Kerenhappuch.
translations.asv: And he called the name of the first, Jemimah: and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.
